title: David Jones as a musician and the Lutcher picture
summary: Jones played tenor and drums and other instruments, appeared in a band photo with Kid Ory, and worked at a music store when Lee Collins was there.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Can you tell us anything else about him as a musician? Did he play mostly tenor? I know he made some records with Lee Collins. Yeah. He played tenor. Did he play other instruments much?

Well, according to his record, he could play several instruments. His place was a drum. Now, we have a picture of him from Lutcher, from Mr. Joseph. Yeah, he got one out at the shop. Of him, Aura, Kid Aura, and Professor David Jones, and Professor Holmes. They had a band of their own way back. And I think that was around 19, I think it was around 19, or 15, or 18. Yeah, when he was playing drums. They got a picture of it all, sir. With Kenori on it.

Yeah, Kenori on it. Yeah, they come up together. Yeah. Yeah. So, Papa John got a picture of him. Yeah. He played in the Lutcher band. He's like the picture of his show of it. Yeah. But David Jones, he played several different instruments. Yeah, he know them all.
Was he living around here, uptown?
He lived up here for years. Oh, yeah. He lived up here for years.
You know who he was working with? Did he have his own band those days when you took lessons, or what was he doing?

Well, yeah, he had played on the TikTok there, Professor David Jones, about in the 30s. I think when Lee Collins was there. Yeah, yeah. David Jones was there. He was at that store when Lee Collins was there.
He made some records then. I just went out there before about 1929, I guess. Yeah, around in that time.
He was at that store at that time. Lee Collins was over there too. Yeah. Yeah. Then later years, after he left, when Rainey come in at that store. Rainey stayed down during the 30s and so forth.
